regression.scope: audit_joint, Phase3 prompt candidate, Phase4 tests, Action split support

final_g0.scope: after storing certification reasons once per source instead of repeating in ledger entries

scenarios: Mismatched Action train, val or test content blocks effective-pool coverage.
Relocated identical raw split files pass with original directory absent, including older request configuration.
Index and adapter references reject retargeted links, same-byte replacement targets, dangling links and parent-directory link changes.
Missing/corrupt manifest or expected SHA mismatch retains suspected overlap and candidate exclusion without coverage.
Uncertified human validation rows do not count as manual support; reasons remain in source report.

phase4_pairing.scope: All training IDs, semantics and shared RGB identities; does not evaluate label accuracy or model outputs.

real_capture.scope: Existing local development data; capture predates final report-only removal of repeated certification_errors in ledger entries.

limitations: No remote server, GPU training, full production replay, CARLA or independent label accuracy validation.
Local Phase4 data covers the existing 140-route subset; full server pool not certified.
Action test export uses mocked native read_rows; real dependency and content checks are exercised.
Existing captures, data, models and hashes remain unchanged. New ZIP and captures stay outside Git.
Old references without logical_path report incomplete; full snapshot byte verification is distinct from external-reference binding verification.
